hooks.name: Commit Reminder
hooks.description: After a spec task completes, checks for uncommitted changes and prints a reminder to commit and push. Zero tokens.

action.command: cd /Users/stan/Documents/GitHub/puenzhiyyy && CHANGED=$(git status --short 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ') && if [ "$CHANGED" -gt "0" ]; then echo ""; echo "⚠️  You have $CHANGED uncommitted change(s). Consider running:"; echo "   git add . && git commit -m 'your message here' && git push"; echo ""; fi
